notes: Governmental funds cash basis, business-type accrual basis (Statement of Net Position p1 headings). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); fund balance roll-forward 1,961,890 + 839,890 - 880,782 + 17,439 (sale of assets) = 1,938,437. Beginning cash not printed (null); ending cash 1,911,413 from the governmental funds statement of assets (p3). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (p3, totals equal the government-wide governmental column 1,938,437), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p6): 881,305 + 315,814 (operating 315,797 + interest income 17) - 297,263 (operating 280,583 + interest 16,680; printed on Statement of Activities p2) = 899,856. Proprietary cash flows from the Total Enterprise Funds column (p7). Detail is per fund column of the governmental funds and proprietary funds statements (as FY2023); the only supplementary schedule (p9, Budget and Actual - All Funds, combined governmental + utility figures) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Capital Outlay 285,666 has no printed function (General Fund column). Read pages 1-9 of 9
